title: Line 3 Housing Defect Report

sections.heading: 2. Description
sections.body: Line 3 produced housings with a hairline crack over a two hour window. See Figure 2 for the crack micrograph.

sections.heading: 3. Timeline
sections.body: Cavity pressure deviation alarm at 06:31; first flagged part 06:40; production paused after hold at 11:40.

sections.heading: 4. Contributing Factors
sections.body: Mold-controller firmware 2.1.1 was running on the affected line. Melt temperature drifted high.
